item.title: Re: Tessa Richards: BMJ editor who championed patients
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor When I met Tessa ten years or so ago, she waited not a minute before she began to recruit me to the Patient Panel of the British Medical Journal. She told me that being both a physician and a patient provided us with a unique opportunity to further the common interests of both groups. item.title: Re: Experts outline “urgent” need for more pregnant women to be included in clinical trials
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor. The British Pharmacological Society (BPS) is correct to highlight the lack of evidence of benefits and harms of medication taken by pregnant and breastfeeding women. The problem stems from their routine exclusion from clinical trials, dating from the time of the thalidomide tragedy. item.title: Re: How does covid-19 affect the skin?
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, This article is really interesting and thanks for publishing it. Recently we have seen an increased number of scabies cases in the community in the Northeast of England and found it difficult to treat at times, as well as difficult to contain in an outbreak situation. item.title: Re: Assessment and prevention of falls in older people and in people 50 and over at higher risk—summary of updated NICE guidance
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor Whilst respecting the thoughtful work gone into this, most of us probably know that much of the guidelines are an ambition rather than a realistic offer to older people who realise themselves that prevention can be better than a fall. The guidelines could usefully include the offer of a hearing test as having ear problems is the cause of many avoidable falls. A simple removal of wax build up can prevent loss of balance. item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor Gilbert’s incisive analysis of the 2026 SEND White Paper critically addresses a system experiencing systemic instability [1]. item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Jeannette M. item.title: Re: Tessa Richards: BMJ editor who championed patients
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, The death of Tessa Richards is a huge loss to both the medical and patient communities. item.title: Re: Fount of filth: Artwork reflects the effects of water pollution on health. Art can communicate what science cannot.
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, As medical professionals, we often overlook our ability to interpret academic papers and derive meaningful conclusions.
